genre.zh: 日本美食雜誌拍台灣小吃（dancyu、Kinfolk 那種眼光）
genre.en: a Japanese food-magazine feature on Taiwanese street food, in the eye of dancyu and Kinfolk: honest food, warm natural light, a real table, steam and crumbs left in

s: the grilled sausages sizzle on a charcoal barbecue grate at dusk, warm firelight from below and a little smoke curling up, the pack standing beside the grill
shot from directly overhead on a tomato-red table: sliced sausages on a plate with garlic and green onion, the pack beside them, hard noon sun with crisp short shadows
a hand lifts one sausage with chopsticks over a night-market style plate, warm string-light glow behind, steam rising

a cooked rice sausage snapped in half to show the rice-and-meat core, held up beside the sealed pack on a terracotta-orange tiled night-market counter, hard late-afternoon sun from the left throwing a long crisp shadow of the sausage across the tiles

the pack lies large in the foreground on a weathered wooden barbecue table, a freshly grilled rice sausage with charred grill marks resting beside it, set against a deep-sea-blue tarpaulin wall, a single hard side light from the right casting sharp shadows

a hand pulling a grilled rice sausage away from a bite so the chewy rice texture stretches, the sealed pack big in the frame below on a tomato-red plastic stool, harsh overhead street-stall sun creating a clear shadow on the red seat

the sealed pack stands upright on a rough concrete barbecue ledge at a camping site against a muted mint-green tent wall, a cooked sausage cut into thick slices laid next to it, hard low sun from behind-left stretching their shadows across the ledge

a cooked spicy rice sausage split open with glossy chili-red juices spilling onto a wooden board next to the sealed pack, set against a tomato-red enamel wall, hard window light from the upper left drawing sharp shadows across the board

the pack sits big on a night-market stall counter of steel and worn wood, a grilled sausage topped with sliced raw garlic resting beside it, background a deep-teal rolling shutter, a hard overhead bulb throwing a crisp shadow below

a hand holding a grilled sausage mid-bite with a dusting of chili flakes and Sichuan pepper falling, the sealed pack large in the foreground on a terracotta-orange tabletop, strong side sun from the right creating long clear shadows
